added.title: Director, Platform Software Engineering
added.description:
Job Description

Leads a platform group; develops strategies and plans that standardize runtimes, APIs, and SDKs across several teams. Accountable for group results and governance adherence; makes operational decisions ensuring compatibility, security, and performance. Sponsors cross-group innovation in resilience, capacity modeling, and interoperability. Communicates with executive leadership on platform health, risk, and adoption.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development:

Define platform strategy for a group, aligning runtimes, SDKs, and integration frameworks to interoperable, multi-tenant standards.
Govern cross-group compatibility and security controls with SRE/security partners; approve high-risk migrations and deprecations.
Own group-wide resilience and capacity objectives; institutionalize rollout, canary, and rollback patterns across services.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

Defines key elements for leads and/or teams to design multiple software solutions and identify and analyze requirements to ensure alignment with business and organizational goals.
Applies broad understanding of other areas within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
Leads design and specification reviews to drive improvements across multiple projects/programs.
Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct leads and/or teams for conducting debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues.
Directs leads and/or teams to implement software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
Drives the optimization of design and development practices to improve performance across products and domains, ensuring adherence to organizational goals in execution of business priorities.
Directs teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
Directs teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

Directs teams to design and develop software, systems, and services.
Coaches managers to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct teams in conducting periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within and outside the organization to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.
Directs teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
Defines processes and approaches to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

Collaborates with stakeholders within and outside of organization, including executive leadership, to understand customer issues and align solutions.
Directs teams to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
Leads teams and sets direction to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
Influences multiple teams to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
Directs the implementation of training for customer issue and/or defect handling processes.
Leads the investigation and troubleshooting of complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

Collaborates with teams and leadership to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, evolving/dynamic industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
Ensures clarity on key elements and objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria to impact development processes in the organization.
Implements complex secure software development practices to prevent security vulnerabilities that affect the organization.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

Defines key elements for teams to perform periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
Ensures teams are aware of and adhere to service contract, terms, and conditions.
Directs teams to proactively evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met. Serves as a role model for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and ensuring alignment with business needs. Coaches others on adjusting resources or project timelines in anticipation of business changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Role models leading cross-functional collaborative efforts to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives. Empowers team to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. Drives transparency and inclusivity by modeling actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

Shares problem-solving strategies across teams, providing oversight on complex operational and/or technical issues, as needed. Coaches teams on analyzing highly complex data and/or information to identify solutions to ambiguous issues and provides direction on identifying root causes to prevent recurrence of issues.

Continuous Learning:

Pursues strategic learning opportunities to maintain expertise and apply best practices at the organizational level. Creates opportunities for team members and leaders to build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to build innovative skills. Identifies skill gap trends across the organization, and upholds a culture that places significant emphasis on sharing knowledge and pursuing learning opportunities that advance the organization. Evaluates efficiency of learning strategies and recommends adjustments as needed.

Continuous Improvement:

Empowers team to own the development and implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Coaches teams to gain buy-in for ideas and to seek feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement. Prioritizes and reviews the roadmap of improvement initiatives to ensure alignment with strategic direction and maximize return on investments.

Performance and Development:

Serves as a role model for driving performance across teams through tailored feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Drives consistency in the application of talent development procedures and socializes performance expectations across the organization. Ensures that individual development goals are aligned with organizational strategic initiatives. Collaborates with HR to implement talent strategy through hiring and promotion processes.

Qualifications

added.title: Vice President, Engineering
added.description:
← All open rolesEngineering

Vice President, Engineering

Toronto or RemoteFull-time

TL;DR

Company: Sensei Labs
Product: Conductor — the AI-powered operating system for strategic programs
Reports to: CTO
Team: 7 direct reports (4 software engineers, 2 quality engineers, and the Platform/DevOps team)
Partnering closely: 2-person Product team and 4-person GTM team
Location: [Toronto / remote]

About Us

Sensei Labs builds Conductor, an enterprise strategy execution platform that governs billions of dollars in program value across hundreds of enterprise programs. Our customers are Fortune 500 transformation offices, global consultancies, and private equity value creation teams. Conductor covers the full lifecycle from portfolio planning through benefits realization, with our Harmony AI layer woven into every surface rather than bolted on.

We've been in the market for more than ten years, we're SOC-2 compliant with a single-tenant architecture, and we do all of it with a deliberately small team. That's the interesting part of this job.

We launched a full rewrite of our Conductor platform a few months ago and are midway through the effort to reach Conductor Modern. Over the next year (or so), this will give us the chance to migrate all our customers and partners to the new version and sunset our old code.

The role

You'll own engineering execution for Conductor: how the team is structured, how work gets from idea to production, and how quickly and reliably we ship. You'll drive the technical strategy and architecture direction, and you'll own the machine that turns that direction into shipped software.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a role that manages managers. With six engineers, you'll be in the code, in the reviews, and in the architecture discussions — while also being the person accountable for delivery, hiring, growth, and the team's day-to-day health. If you want a position where you can both set long-term strategy and have immediate day-to-day impact, this is the seat.

As part of our modernization, you’ll be directly involved in any remaining architectural and technical decisions for Conductor Modern and be a key part of planning for the customer migration and the ultimate sunsetting of the existing codebase.

This is the third leg of the Sensei Labs stool, along with our established Product and GTM leaders. You’ll work closely with them to shape and implement Product’s vision and to enable our GTM team to sell and deliver value to our customers and partners.

What You'll Own

Delivery. Planning, sequencing, and shipping against a roadmap you help build with Product. Predictable releases, visible progress, honest tradeoffs.
The team. Coaching and growing six engineers, running performance and career conversations, hiring as we scale, and keeping the bar high without burning people out.
Cloud platform and reliability. Architecture, scalability, cost, and operational excellence for a single-tenant enterprise SaaS platform. Uptime, performance, and security posture are yours. You'll lead our Platform/DevOps team alongside product engineering, setting direction for infrastructure and application architecture, performance and scalability, cloud cost management, and the tooling that the rest of engineering builds on. Uptime, operational excellence, and security posture are yours.
AI in the product. Partnering with Product on how Harmony AI evolves — agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and permission-aware AI behavior in an enterprise context.
AI in how we build. Making our SDLC substantially faster and more automated: AI-assisted coding, code review, and test generation; CI/CD; automated quality gates. We want an engineering org where a small team ships like a large one, and you'll be the one who builds that.
Engineering–Product partnership. Working shoulder to shoulder with Product on discovery, scope, and sequencing. You'll be expected to have opinions about the product, not just the plumbing.
Enterprise trust. Security, compliance, and the technical side of customer and prospect conversations when it matters.

What We're Looking For

Cloud infrastructure and application architecture at depth.

You've architected, built, and operated production cloud SaaS at meaningful scale — not just supervised it. You're fluent across both layers: the application architecture (service boundaries, data modeling, API design, and the patterns that keep a large codebase evolvable) and the infrastructure underneath it. Hands-on depth in Azure and/or GCP is essential, along with container orchestration on Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, networking and identity, and the observability and cost discipline that keep a cloud platform healthy as it grows. You understand multi-tenancy versus single-tenancy tradeoffs, data isolation, performance under enterprise load, and what "SOC-2 compliant" actually costs an engineering team.

Real product instinct.

You've worked in product-led environments where engineering shapes what gets built. You can push back on a spec, spot the simpler solution, and reason about customer value — especially in complex B2B software where the user is an enterprise operator, not a consumer.

Team leadership with your hands still dirty.

You've led and grown engineering teams (roughly 5–20 people) as a player-coach. You've hired well, given hard feedback, and relentlessly tuned the delivery process.

AI fluency, both directions.

You've shipped AI or LLM-backed features into production — and you've also rebuilt how a team works using AI-assisted development and automated SDLC tooling. You can tell the difference between AI that creates leverage and AI that creates cleanup work.

Startup temperament.

You're comfortable being both the strategist and the person who fixes the flaky test. You'd rather own an outcome than a headcount number.

Nice to have

Enterprise PPM, EPMO, transformation, or professional services domain experience
Experience with Microsoft 365 / SAP / Jira / Power BI integration ecosystems
Background in selling or supporting technical evaluations with Fortune 500 or PE buyers
Experience taking a mature product through an AI-era re-platforming or modernization

Your first year

By 90 days — you know the codebase, the team, and the roadmap; you've shipped something meaningful yourself; and you've given us a clear read on our biggest delivery and technical risks.
By 6 months — the development lifecycle is measurably faster, with AI-assisted workflows and automated quality gates that the team actually uses. Release cadence is predictable.
By 12 months — engineering is a genuine competitive advantage: shipping AI capability into Conductor at a pace that surprises much larger competitors, with a team that's grown in both size and capability.

Why this role

Small team, real enterprise customers, an established product, and an unusually good excuse to rebuild how software gets made. You won't be one VP among many, and you won't be managing a slide deck about AI transformation — you'll be doing it, on a product whose entire premise is helping large organizations actually execute.

At PLEXSYS, we’re all about creating Live, Virtual, and Constructive (LVC) training solutions for our customers worldwide. With over 200 employees spread across fifteen states and four countries, we’re dedicated to enhancing training experiences every day, everywhere.

Why PLEXSYS?

At PLEXSYS, you’ll be part of a dynamic and supportive culture that encourages you to reach your professional goals, put forth your best effort, and collaborate with other enthusiastic and driven individuals. Our core values – integrity, excellence, teamwork, and agility – are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our decisions and shaping our vibrant organizational culture.

PLEXSYS is an amazing place to work, but you don’t have to take our word for it. We invite you to check out what our team members are saying about working at PLEXSYS on Glassdoor. Discover why PLEXSYS could be the perfect place for the next step in your career.

General Description

The Director of Engineering leads execution of prototyping and solution support activities as the technical interface to BD and Customer Ops. Owns technical proposal content (BoEs, estimates, Technical Volumes), value propositions, and customer‑aligned demonstrations. Coordinates closely with the VP of Product Development on technical direction and execution priorities; manages small teams to deliver prototypes, capture technical feedback, and validates solution feasibility.

Duties & Responsibilities

Leads prototyping projects to support customer discovery, early validation, and demos. Documents feedback and lessons learned.
Provides input to product roadmap alignment to customer roadmap and requirements mapping.
Provides technical support to capture efforts: writes and reviews BoEs, estimates, technical volumes, and value propositions.
Coordinates on budgeting with the Production Leadership for resource planning and shared infrastructure requirements.
Develops performance standards for direct reports and evaluates their performance to ensure alignment with PLEXSYS policies, organizational objectives, and contributions toward those objectives
Attends conferences and tradeshows to support capture efforts, and to present the organization’s technical solutions and white papers.
Leads technical reviews and authorship contributions for cross functional business proposals. Contributions include requirements analysis, basis of estimates (BOEs), customer engagement and collaboration.
Drives solution and technology exploration in support of proposals and early validation, estimates related to the corporate strategic growth initiatives.
Collaborates with platform and shared library owners, ensures prototypes and solutions leverage common infrastructure where feasible.
Coordinate with Export Compliance and serves as technical point-of-contact for CUI and Classified engagements.
Other duties, as assigned

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent, a Master of Science and/or MBA is preferred
Minimum of eight (8) years of software development experience
Minimum of four (4) years of team management experience
Strong relationship builder and communicator with experience leading and managing diverse software development teams and engaging customers to ensure outcomes met or exceeded requirements

Promote and adhere to PLEXSYS core values
Ability to travel periodically to provide on-site Engineering and Development support and for meeting with current and potential customers
Ability to motivate teams and simultaneously manage several projects

Desirable

At least two (2) years of experience supporting capture and proposal exercises
At least two (2) years of progressive professional software development experience at PLEXSYS with experience managing software development projects
Experience working with modelling and simulation software products and concepts
Military experience in a Command and Control or Intelligence Reconnaissance and Surveillance career field
Familiarity with SISO and DMO Standards

AUTHORITY

Ability to obtain and maintain a minimum Secret level security clearance, Top Secret preferred
Hiring and firing authority within assigned team and in coordination with HR
Signature authority as defined within the PLEXSYS policy

As a PLEXSYS employee, you can expect certain advantages; such as advancement based on performance, competitive wages, valuable benefits and a great working environment. Our team is committed to ensuring an environment that empowers individuals to realize their full potential by providing opportunities and necessary support to achieve personal and professional goals.

Join the Clean Energy Revolution

Become a Data Engineering, Senior Manager
at Southern California Edison (SCE) and build a better tomorrow. In this leadership role, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction and execution of data engineering solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across Transmission & Distribution (T&D). You will lead a team of data engineers and analytics professionals in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data platforms, integration pipelines, and enterprise data products that support operational, financial, performance and strategic objectives. As a Senior Manager, you will oversee the development of modern data architectures and cloud-based analytics solutions leveraging technologies such as Python, SQL, Snowflake, and low-code platforms including Palantir Foundry. You will drive data governance, data quality, and best practices for managing large and complex datasets while ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient delivery of business-critical data assets. Additionally, you will partner closely with operational leaders, technology teams, and executive stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and deliver innovative solutions that improve performance, increase efficiency, and unlock business value.

As a Data Engineering, Senior Manager
, your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions and create cleaner air for everyone. Are you ready to take on the challenge to help us build the future?

Responsibilities

Establishes departmental objectives and leads the strategic direction for data engineering to support enterprise-wide data initiatives and business transformation.
Manages the activities of the data engineering department through subordinate managers, ensuring delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performing data platforms and pipelines.
Defines and implements standards, processes, and operational plans that align with business strategy and enable consistent, high-quality data delivery.
Develops and manages departmental budgets, staffing plans, and performance metrics to ensure efficient use of resources and achievement of goals.
Collaborates with senior leaders across data, IT, and business functions to prioritize initiatives, align architecture decisions, and deliver integrated data solutions.
Oversees the implementation of data governance, metadata management, and data quality frameworks to ensure compliance, trust, and reusability of data assets.
Contributes to the development and execution of company-wide data policies and programs, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and technology strategy.
A material job duty of all positions within the Company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity.

Minimum Qualifications

Five or more years of experience supervising a team of direct reports and/or project management.
Experience with data processing large data sets hands-on with data transformation aggregation and filtering.

Preferred Qualifications

Proven experience leading data engineering, analytics, or data platform teams, including responsibility for strategy, delivery execution, resource planning, and talent development.
Demonstrated experience overseeing the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise data integration solutions, APIs, and ETL/ELT pipelines using technologies such as Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, or similar platforms.

Live Nestle leadership principles in all aspects of the role.
Set the technical strategic vision for the factory, leveraging other functional leaders and cascade objectives to all leaders in engineering department, within factory cost targets.
Develop and maintain technical competencies at the factory, including detailed action plans, accountability to progress, talent review, career and succession planning.
Drive equipment reliability through implementing maintenance foundations in TPM.
Build cooperation and collaboration with the production and other cross functional teams to build world class operation.
Improve maintenance cost structure by improving technical skill sets and optimizing 3rd party spend.
Implement Nestle capital process to drive excellence in capital execution.
Proactively develop, maintain and execute the capital market business strategy (MBS) to align with the business needs.
Drive factory master planning to facilitate long term strategies across the factory for example in Safety, Quality and Warehouse.

Maintain reliability through implementing maintenance foundations and TPM methodology.
Develop and maintain all skillset necessary for internal management of utilities systems.
Drive and execute plant sustainability objectives in line with market targets.
Drive world class water management in the factory.
Drive reliability in all electrical components in the factory.
Develop and drive automation plan for the factory.
Ensure full compliance with Nestle standards including calibration.

Drive Innovation/Renovation, initiating/coordinating implementation of new processes/technology with relevant Market, Product Technology Center, Corporate and Strategic Business Unit.
Cascaded objectives to all leaders that are in-line with factory objectives

Detailed cost management plan for all aspects of engineering including YoY improvements.

Maintenance Foundations/TPM.
Corporate resources and Nestle Market standards.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to Team

Expedia Group Technology enables Expedia Group to deliver innovative, reliable, and scalable technology solutions that help travelers explore the world and partners grow their businesses.

This Senior Manager Software Engineering Development role is part of the BEX Engineering Home team which sits within our Technoolgy division. The team owns end-to-end engineering for Brand Expedia experiences, including Home, Attach, and Trip Management, while partnering with shared platform teams to deliver differentiated traveler journeys. The main impact of this role is to lead technical strategy and execution that delivers measurable business and traveler outcomes through scalable, reliable software solutions.

You will bring balanced judgment across people, technology, and delivery—helping the team create a truly traveller-centric Expedia experience, make thoughtful trade-offs, learn quickly, and deliver with quality.

What You’ll Do

Lead, support, and grow a diverse team of six to seven software engineers through clear expectations, regular feedback, coaching, career development, and inclusive team practices.
Own the team’s engineering direction and delivery roadmap for Brand Expedia Home across web and native app experiences, in partnership with Product and cross-functional stakeholders.
Build strong working relationships with Brand Expression, Merchandising, Design, Product, Platform, and engineering partners across Expedia to align priorities and create a cohesive traveller journey.
Translate ambiguous traveller and business problems into pragmatic technical approaches and executable plans that help travellers take the next best step in their journey.
Guide system design, low-level design, API design, data modeling, and architecture decisions, balancing traveller value, simplicity, scalability, performance, accessibility, security, reliability, and cost.
Champion a traveller-centric product and engineering culture by bringing customer insight, experimentation, data, and feedback into roadmap and delivery decisions.
Build a culture of end-to-end ownership across design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement.
Promote high engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, documentation, CI/CD, operational readiness, and responsible use of AI-assisted development practices.
Stay technically engaged through design reviews, prototypes, and production debugging while developing the team’s technical breadth across frontend, backend, web, native app, and platform capabilities.
Partner with engineers and technical leaders to identify risks early, remove delivery bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and communicate progress and trade-offs clearly.
Use product and engineering metrics to evaluate outcomes, improve the roadmap, and stop or reshape work that is not creating sufficient value.
Hire, retain, and develop the talent needed to meet the team’s evolving goals while ensuring opportunities are accessible and equitable.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve traveller outcomes and team effectiveness.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred.
8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people management experience.
Experience leading and developing a software engineering team, with a track record of building trust, accountability, collaboration, and belonging.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and technical judgment across system design, low-level design, architecture, API design, data modeling, testing, and operational excellence in distributed or cloud-based environments.
Experience delivering customer-facing or business-critical software across multiple quarters, from problem definition through production outcomes, with end-to-end ownership of services or multi-service systems.
Ability to connect technical decisions to measurable product and business outcomes and make transparent trade-offs as priorities or constraints change.
Experience partnering effectively with Product, Design, Merchandising, Brand or Marketing, Program Management, Platform, and senior stakeholders to align priorities and resolve ambiguity.
Commitment to developing people through timely feedback, coaching, mentorship, thoughtful delegation, and meaningful career conversations.
Clear, audience-aware communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics simply and create alignment across disciplines.
Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, with a continuous-improvement mindset and a responsible, pragmatic approach to AI across the software development lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or operating high-scale, highly available, customer-facing web or mobile experiences, particularly homepage, storefront, discovery, search, or shopping experiences.
Experience and understanding of native app architecture alongside web architecture, including platform-specific trade-offs and the delivery of cohesive experiences across web, iOS, and Android.
Proficiency with modern frontend systems such as React and TypeScript, including component-based architecture, frontend testing, accessibility, and web performance.
Experience developing backend services with Kotlin or Java, Spring Boot, and GraphQL or REST APIs.
Experience designing or operating experience APIs, including server-driven UI or content-composition patterns, downstream service aggregation, and API contracts consumed by web and native clients.
Experience building modular, configurable, or content-driven templates and shared UI components that enable differentiated experiences to be delivered efficiently and safely.
Experience designing and operating cloud-based distributed systems, preferably on AWS, with CI/CD, observability, SLOs, incident response, performance, and resilience practices.
Experience with data stores and integration patterns such as SQL or NoSQL databases, caching, asynchronous communication, and fault-tolerant service design.
Prior work on high-traffic consumer-facing experiences — ideally homepage, storefront, or discovery. Experimentation (A/B testing, personalisation).
Experience with experimentation and learning systems, including A/B testing, feature flags, personalization, analytics, or other data-informed methods for improving customer journeys.
Familiarity with accessibility, internationalization, and inclusive design considerations for products serving travellers across markets and user needs.
Experience safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled capabilities or AI-assisted engineering tools, with attention to evaluation, privacy, security, reliability, governance, and measurable value.

Driven by integrity, we find strong purpose in the work we do and an even greater joy in those we get to work alongside. Discover your purpose and fuel your passions when you join a team that prides itself on the power of togetherness—We are Proudly Connected. Purely Driven.

As Senior Manager Engineering Logistics, you will establish and execute the strategic direction for automated material handling systems (AMHS) within the Nestlé and Nestlé Purina U.S. network. Through your collaboration with technical experts, vendors and factory stakeholders, you will develop vertical startup and sustainment programs for automated storage and retrieval systems (ASRS), monorails, robotics and other automated logistics assets. Come prepared to guide standards development for design, training and startup execution as well as communicate plans and results to executive leadership.

Lead a team of subject matter experts to design, execute and standardize startup of AMHS
Sustain AMHS performance at current facilities through application of best practices and ways of working to proactively identify opportunities and determine corrective measures
Develop and deploy physical logistics equipment maintenance strategies, monitor and report performance, and ensure technical requirements are met, documented, trained and sustained
Facilitate and prioritize process improvement efforts for teams and factories with a focus on Nestlé Continuous Excellence (NCE,) goal alignment, and coordination with parallel Nestlé initiatives
Define and clearly communicate strategy and plans with key stakeholders in Supply Chain and Engineering to expedite smooth project transitions
Ensure warehouse physical logistics compliance with all applicable Nestlé standards and guidelines and prioritize food safety and hygienic engineering while optimizing efficiency

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical discipline with 10+ years of experience in food manufacturing or consumer goods industry including maintenance, operations and capital project responsibilities –AND-- 3+ years leading physical logistics engineering including automated warehouse operations and automated material handling systems

OR

High school diploma or GED equivalent with 12+ years of experience in food manufacturing or consumer goods industry including maintenance, operations and capital project responsibilities --AND-- 5+ years leading physical logistics engineering including automated warehouse operations and automated material handling systems

Must be willing to travel 50%-75% based on business needs

added.description:
Job title:Senior Director, Patient Support Services Platform Solutions

Location: Cambridge, MA

About The Job

The Senior Director, Patient Support Services (PSS) Platform Solutions will drive the transformation of Sanofi Specialty Care PSS across Therapeutic Areas through strategic and tactical leadership of platform development, projects and programs that will optimize the patient experience, improve productivity, and increase automation. Responsibility will span all applicable technology platforms including but not limited to PSS CRMs and Events Management tools. The ideal candidate will bring a strong enterprise mindset, with the ability to architect and drive scalable solutions across multiple therapy archetypes, ensuring platform strategies are both cohesive at the enterprise level and responsive to the unique needs of each therapeutic area.

The candidate must be solution-oriented, operationally savvy, creative, highly organized, flexible, resilient in a fast changing environment, and adept at working in a matrix environment where commercial and digital functions intersect, handling multiple projects with tight deadlines and multiple stakeholders. He/She must be able to lead and influence across leadership and teams. This will be a highly visible position interacting with many internal functional groups within Sanofi Specialty Care PSS, as well as external vendors. The position will report to the Head, of Patient Support Services Program Operations.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, youll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities

Leadership

Lead, structure, and develop the Platform Solutions Team, establishing clear ways of working and internal processes that enable the team to operate effectively

Manage and influence cross-functional teams and external vendor partners to drive flawless execution of complex, multi-stakeholder platform initiatives on time and within budget

Act as a confident and independent voice at the interface between PSS and Digital, able to challenge either side constructively when warranted to achieve the best possible outcome

Proactively identify and mitigate risks, resolve conflicts, and remove barriers to execution through strong influencing skills and executive presence

Business Requirements and UAT Ownership

Serve as the accountable Business Owner for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across platform releases, ensuring the team fulfils its end-to-end UAT responsibilities including test case input, execution oversight, and go/ no-go sign off in line with Sanofi policy.

Oversee the teams ownership of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), ensuring requirements are developed collaboratively with Therapy Areas, Product Owners and other functions, and that they consistently meet the standard required for build readiness

Establish and embed team practices and quality standards for BRD development and UAT execution, ensuring the team has the structure, support, and process clarity to perform these accountabilities consistently across releases and TAs

Strategic Vision & Product Ownership

Serve as the strategic product owner for PSS platform solutions, defining vision, roadmap, and prioritization of features that deliver measurable business value and enhanced patient outcomes

Drive automation and evolution of the CRM ecosystem enabling integrated innovation

Accountable for PSS roadmap ownership to include new launches, innovation and optimization of current systems

Owner of business process documentation, alignment, grooming, release communication and training of system changes

Innovation

Collaborate with Head of Program Operations, Digital, and PSS Innovation to architect advanced analytics and real-time intelligence capabilities that transform platform data into actionable insights, predictive analytics, and strategic business intelligence that drives continuous optimization and innovation beyond traditional reporting

Enterprise Focus & Scalability

Apply enterprise-level thinking to design scalable, future-proof platform solutions that can be leveraged across multiple therapy archetypes, ensuring consistency, interoperability, and efficiency at scale

Lead end-to-end enterprise solutioning by connecting business needs across diverse therapy archetypes to unified platform strategies that reduce redundancy and accelerate time-to-value

Serve as the enterprise product owner across PSS platforms, driving a cohesive product strategy that balances therapy-specific needs with enterprise-wide standards and scalability

Stakeholder Management

Develop and execute comprehensive stakeholder communication strategies that ensure alignment, transparency, and buy-in across all levels of the organization, from operational teams to executive leadership

Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences, facilitating informed decision-making and strategic alignment

About You

A minimum of a Bachelor's Degree is required

A minimum of 10+ years of professional experience in the Biotech/Pharma industry is required

A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience leading the design, implementation, and optimization of CRM systems (Salesforce, Salesforce Health Cloud, or equivalent enterprise platforms) is required

A minimum of 5+ years of experience leading and managing teams

Demonstrated experience building CRM solutions from the ground up, including requirements gathering, system architecture, user experience design, and post-launch optimization

Proven track record of strategic thinking with the ability to envision long-term platform evolution, anticipate industry trends, and translate business strategy into actionable technology roadmaps

Exceptional stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to build consensus, negotiate priorities, and drive alignment across multiple stakeholders with competing interests pared with the independence and confidence to constructively challenge stakeholders when direction is misaligned or standards are not being met

Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to craft and deliver compelling presentations, facilitate productive meetings, and maintain clear, consistent communication across all organizational levels

Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and developing teams of technical and functional professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Proven product ownership capabilities including backlog management, user story development, sprint planning, and delivering iterative value in agile environments

Demonstrated literacy across delivery and program tooling, including Jira or equivalent platforms, with the ability to operate within and set standards for how the team tracks, manages, and reports on work

Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with all cross-functional groups across levels

Strong presentation skills and ability to influence without direct authority

Selected candidate will possess strong and proven Project Management skills

Demonstrated ability to manage and execute multiple complex initiatives simultaneously while maintaining quality, meeting deadlines, and adapting to changing priorities

Track record of driving measurable business outcomes through platform solutions, with strong analytical skills to define success metrics and demonstrate ROI

Demonstrated enterprise thinking with the ability to architect holistic, scalable solutions that span multiple therapy archetypes, balancing standardization with the flexibility required to meet unique therapeutic area needs

Strong product ownership across diverse therapy archetypes, with a track record of managing competing priorities, aligning stakeholders across therapeutic areas, and delivering platform solutions that meet both enterprise and therapy-specific requirements

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Degree in Information Technology, MBA or closely related field is highly preferred

Knowledge of Specialty Care market is preferred Current or recent experience with Scaled Agile Methodology is preferred

Why Choose Us

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether its through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness program

added.title: VP Digital & Technology Solutions Partner - Finance, Accounting & Oracle ERP
added.description:
Regeneron is a leading biotechnology company built on a simple but powerful mission: to use the power of science to bring new medicines to patients, over and over again. Founded and led by physician-scientists, we've turned that mission into one of the industry's most productive pipelines, nearly all of it homegrown in our own laboratories, powered by proprietary technologies like our VelociSuite platform. From Dupixent and EYLEA to a rapidly expanding portfolio across oncology, cardiovascular and metabolic disease, neuroscience, and rare disease, our science is reaching millions of patients worldwide, and we're just getting started.

As we invest billions in new manufacturing capacity, expand our global footprint, and build the next generation of digital and technology capabilities to match the scale of our ambition, Regeneron offers a rare combination: the resources and reach of an industry leader, paired with the energy, curiosity, and relentless focus on invention of a company still writing its next chapter. This is a place where technology doesn't just support the business, it accelerates the science that changes patients' lives.

Role Description

Regeneron is seeking a Vice President to lead the digital and technology portfolio for Finance, Investor Relations, Facilities Management, Audit, Tax, Treasury and software delivery compliance across G&A. This role will also have accountability for the largest single application environment at Regeneron, our Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) and Fusion platforms. This executive owns the technology backbone for how a leading global biotechnology company manages its finances, engages investors, runs its workplaces, and governs how software is built and released worldwide.

Scope & Impact

This executive sets enterprise technology strategy across multiple corporate functions and leads through a team of directors and managers. Decisions carry enterprise-level impact on company performance; this individual influences executive stakeholders on the most significant matters and represents technology with external partners.

What You'll Lead

Set enterprise technology strategy across Finance, Investor Relations, Facilities Management, Audit, Tax, and Treasury, partnering with senior business leaders to align the Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), Fusion, and related platform roadmaps with corporate strategy, operational priorities, and company-wide performance goals.

Lead a multi-team technology organization through directors, managers, and a large network of external professionals.

Drive measurable business outcomes by improving key performance indicators such as financial close cycle time, forecast accuracy, working capital visibility, reporting timeliness, controls effectiveness, automation adoption, system reliability, and user productivity across Finance and adjacent corporate functions.

Lead the Oracle EBS and Fusion platform strategies, including modernization and integration decisions.

Own the multi-year transformation roadmap across Finance and G&A systems, prioritizing investments, sequencing modernization initiatives, simplifying legacy complexity, and driving adoption of new digital capabilities.

Establish and govern the Finance data, analytics, and decision intelligence strategy, including data quality, master data alignment, trusted executive reporting, and analytics capabilities that enable faster and more confident business decisions.

Drive global operating model and process standardization across regions, legal entities, shared services, and business units, with emphasis on close, planning, procure-to-pay, treasury, tax, audit, and reporting workflows.

Manage strategic vendors, managed services, implementation partners, and technology spend with accountability for partner performance, contract outcomes, portfolio prioritization, and financial discipline across the supported systems landscape.

Strengthen resilience and operational risk management for mission-critical finance platforms, partnering across cybersecurity, access governance, disaster recovery, incident response, and business continuity to protect critical business operations.

Define and advance the AI strategy and AI agent roadmap for Regenerons financial operations, identifying high-value opportunities to automate work, improve decision support, strengthen controls, and responsibly scale AI-enabled capabilities across Finance and related corporate functions.

Direct more than 1,000 integration points between Regenerons financial applications and boundary systems.

Support the systems strategy and delivery capabilities for global financial consolidations, statutory reporting, and operational performance reporting.

Own the technology systems and controls supporting Audit, Tax, and Treasury, and establish enterprise software development lifecycle (SDLC) standards and governance across the Commercial and G&A technology organization.

Ensure SOX-compliant technology operations across in-scope financial systems, with accountability for effective controls execution, audit readiness, remediation of control gaps, and consistently strong internal and external audit results.

What You Bring

BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field required; MBA preferred.

18+ years of progressive technology leadership, including finance systems and enterprise platforms such as Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) and/or Oracle Fusion. Candidates with extensive SAP FI/CO leadership experience may be considered.

A history of successful executive command of finance technology, investor relations, facilities/real estate systems, and audit, tax, or treasury platforms; familiarity with SDLC governance frameworks is a plus.

Proven ability to lead at enterprise scale, influence executive stakeholders, negotiate the most complex matters, and attract top talent.

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. added.description:
Hiring for a client, Johor Capital Group, Infratech

Company Description

Johor Capital Group (JCG) is the patient capital arm of Johor Corporation, established to drive high-impact digital and inclusive growth for Malaysia’s new economy. Positioned as a catalytic investment engine and innovation orchestrator, JCG deploys patient capital into emerging and high-growth sectors, including digital solutions, advanced infrastructure, fibre and connectivity, agrofood and renewable energy. Through strategic investments and innovation-led initiatives, JCG aims to create sustainable long-term value and contribute to a more inclusive, resilient and future-ready economy.

Job Summary

Based at Menara KOMTAR, Johor Bahru, the Head, Network Infrastructure
to lead the strategy, planning and delivery of terrestrial fibre and network infrastructure projects. The role is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end infrastructure delivery lifecycle, including network architecture, design assurance, procurement, civil works, fibre installation, testing, commissioning and operational handover.

The successful candidate will provide technical and commercial leadership across project governance, contractor management, cost control, regulatory coordination, risk management and stakeholder engagement. The role will also lead technical discussions with carriers, hyperscalers, infrastructure partners and prospective collaborators to ensure network solutions are resilient, scalable, commercially viable and aligned with business and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Network Infrastructure Strategy and Planning

Lead the network infrastructure roadmap for MYDS and other approved terrestrial fibre projects, aligned with business demand, customer commitments and investment priorities.
Approve deployment options, route strategy, fibre capacity, diversity, resiliency and phased rollout recommendations for management consideration.
Translate approved business cases into delivery plans, governance gates, resource requirements and measurable project outcomes.
Oversee network architecture and ensure designs allow future expansion, interoperability and open access where required.
Identify strategic delivery dependencies, including rights of way, utilities, permits, site access and interconnection points.

2. Project Portfolio and Delivery Governance

Direct the planning and execution of network infrastructure projects across design, procurement, civil works, fibre installation, testing and handover.
Set baselines for scope, schedule, cost, quality and risk, and chair periodic project reviews with delivery leads and contractors.
Approve practical work packages and delivery sequencing within delegated authority, and escalate changes that affect approved business cases or commitments.
Coordinate readiness for customer service dates and ensure deployment milestones align with commercial contracts and operational acceptance.

3. Design, BOQ and Technical Assurance

Own the technical review and validation of designs, specifications, bill of quantities and contractor proposals before procurement or execution.
Challenge quantities, unit rates, route assumptions and scope gaps against surveys, approved designs and market benchmarks.
Evaluate material variations, value engineering options and claims, and recommend approval or rejection with cost and schedule impacts.
Ensure completed assets match approved designs, technical standards, records and network capacity requirements.
Network Operation Set-Up/NOC advisor with solution evaluation.

4. Contractor and Vendor Leadership

Lead procurement input, technical evaluation and performance management for fibre deployment contractors, engineering consultants and key suppliers.
Set contractor deliverables and service levels covering schedule, quality, safety, documentation and rectification periods.
Resolve cross-contractor interfaces and resource constraints, and intervene when performance threatens milestones.
Review claims, disputes and corrective action plans with Procurement, Finance and Legal as appropriate.

5. Budget, Cost and Commercial Discipline

Own project expenditure forecasts and maintain delivery within approved budgets and delegated variation limits.
Review committed cost, actual cost, cost to complete and cash flow forecasts; explain deviations and propose recovery actions.
Validate contractor progress claims and variations against measured work and contract terms before payment recommendation.
Identify cost optimisation opportunities without weakening network quality, resilience or customer commitments.

6. Schedule, Quality and Handover

Maintain an integrated master schedule and critical path across permits, design, procurement, construction, fibre works, testing and commissioning.
Direct recovery plans for delayed activities and communicate material changes to customer readiness dates.
Set quality assurance and acceptance requirements, including OTDR testing, splicing, labelling, inspection and defect closure.
Ensure as-built drawings, route and asset records, test results, permits and warranties are complete before operational handover.
Approve technical handover recommendations and transition the network to Operations with clear ownership of outstanding items.

7. Stakeholder, Regulatory and HSE Interfaces

Represent Network Infrastructure in engagements with PLUS and other right-of-way owners, utilities, local authorities, customers and strategic partners.
Oversee permits, traffic management, site access and other external dependencies with the responsible internal teams.
Ensure contractors comply with applicable HSE requirements and site rules; escalate serious incidents through the established process.
Align technical decisions with Commercial, Finance, Procurement, Legal and Operations requirements.

8. Risk Management and Management Reporting

Maintain portfolio-level risk and issue registers covering right of way, approvals, cost, schedule, safety, quality, contractor performance and network readiness.
Sponsor mitigation and contingency plans for material risks, with owners, deadlines and decisions required.
Provide concise monthly management reports on milestones, expenditure, forecast completion, risks, decisions and customer commitments.
Present investment, variation and recovery recommendations to the relevant approval forums with supporting evidence.

9. People and Capability Leadership

Lead, coach and allocate the network infrastructure delivery team; define responsibilities and performance expectations.
Build internal capability in fibre design, cost validation, project controls, testing, documentation and operational handover.
Establish consistent project controls, templates and lessons learned across the network infrastructure portfolio.

10. Engagement with Customers and Partners Where Technical Is Concerned

Lead technical discussions with carriers, hyperscalers, infrastructure partners and prospective collaborators on network routes, capacity, diversity, interfaces, service readiness and delivery feasibility across local and international markets.
Assist the Sales/Business Development team in exploring technical designs with optimisation of cost structures.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Civil Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
Minimum 12 years of relevant experience
in telecommunications, terrestrial fibre or network infrastructure, including at least 5 years in a leadership or senior management capacity
.
Proven experience managing the end-to-end delivery of large-scale fibre or network infrastructure projects, covering design, procurement, civil works, installation, testing, commissioning and operational handover.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required.
Strong technical knowledge of fibre-optic network architecture, route planning, network capacity, diversity, resiliency, splicing, OTDR testing and Network Operations Centre requirements.
Demonstrated experience in project governance, contractor and vendor management, cost control, budgeting, Bill of Quantities validation, variation management and commercial evaluation.
Experience engaging with carriers, hyperscalers, infrastructure partners, right-of-way owners, utilities, local authorities and other regulatory stakeholders.
Strong understanding of permits, rights of way, traffic management, site access, Health, Safety and Environment requirements, and other dependencies affecting infrastructure deployment.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects, delivery schedules, critical paths, project risks and customer service commitments.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, analytical and decision-making capabilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical, commercial and project matters clearly to senior management and external stakeholders.
Willingness to travel to project sites and other locations as required.

added.title: Director, Data Products & Engineering
added.description:
The Director, Data Products & Engineering, leads the development, expansion, and delivery of Plymouth Rock’s enterprise data assets within the enterprise data lake on AWS. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of ingestion, transformation, and data availability pipelines and is measured on throughput, reliability, and speed of delivery. This role is responsible for ensuring that the enterprise data lake is complete, high-fidelity, low-latency, and continuously expanding to meet the needs of Business Intelligence, Machine Learning, and AI data services and consumption patterns.

Leader will partner closely with business and IT leaders, as well as the heads of Data Governance and Data Services, to ensure that Plymouth Rock’s data distribution and consumption are well organized, well governed, and accessible at speed and scale. This leader spends the majority of their time working within the data lake platform: reviewing pipeline designs, unblocking engineers, troubleshooting production issues, and driving delivery velocity of the data lake, all in service of the organization’s AI ambitions.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Product Strategy & Delivery

Draw from your deep and broad technical and management expertise to mentor senior engineers and managers, complete hands-on technical work, and provide leadership on complex technical issues, design tradeoffs, and feature and schedule prioritization.
Define the processes needed to achieve operational excellence in all areas including process management, resiliency and quality
Conduct research of strategic & emerging trends, lead proofs of concept and continuously drive innovation across the team
Lead the development of enterprise data products aligned to business and domains, ensuring data is structured, accessible, and reusable.
Define and prioritize the data roadmap in alignment with business needs, AI/ML use cases, and platform evolution.

Continuous, Rapid Data Expansion (Depth & Breadth)

Execute ingestion of structured, unstructured, and streaming data sources into the lake, closing data leakage gaps by capturing data directly from frontline systems.
Own hands-on delivery of the AWS data lake using S3, Glue, EMR, Lake Formation, Athena, Kinesis, and RDS/Aurora — architecting, reviewing, and, when needed, directly building pipeline components.
Drive continuous improvement of ingestion speed, pipeline reliability, and processing efficiency through concrete, measurable engineering changes each sprint.
Own production reliability of the data lake: monitoring, incident response, root-cause resolution, and prevention of recurring failures.
Partner with application teams to eliminate data leakage by capturing all data generated by frontline systems.

Data Engineering & Platform Execution

Deep hands-on experience with core AWS data services, including S3, Glue, EMR, Lake Formation, Athena, Kinesis, and RDS/Aurora
Optimize the storage patterns of all enterprise data assets to ensure accessibility, cost efficiency, stability, and reliability, while ensuring that data is curated, standardized, partitioned, and stored in the appropriate layer of the Data Lake medallion architecture.
Ensure ingestion metadata (including process and lineage) is complete, accurate, and consistent with governance standards, and that business tools/processes hosting and applying business semantics at the appropriate point in curation are stable and fast.
Lead teams of data engineers and product owners responsible for ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data across the enterprise data warehouse and data lake.
Continuously improve data ingestion speed, pipeline reliability, and processing efficiency.
Embed business context into data product development, ensuring outputs are actionable and aligned to operational needs.
Partner with Data Governance & Architecture to ensure data products align with standards. Ensure consistent, well-organized documentation.

Agile Product Execution & Scaled Delivery

Organize data platform into an agile product structure.
Ensure products squads deliver incrementally and are accountable for measurable outcomes aligned to the objectives of the data office.
Establish and manage agile delivery practices, including sprint cycles, backlog prioritization, and release management.
Coordinate Applications, Data Services, and AI/ML teams ensuring alignment across interdependent data ingestion, and consumption workstreams.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Engineering, Actuarial Science, Business Administration, or a related field required.
Master's degree (MS in Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, or Information Management) preferred.

Experience Preferred

7+ years of experience in data management, engineering, or related disciplines.
3+ years of successful senior leadership experience managing enterprise data or analytics functions.
Expertise in data quality management and data architecture best practices, including strong understanding of AI/GenAI data needs, including text, image, and structured data preparation.
Expertise in agile development methods including implementing scale agile methods in a cross-functional environment.
P&C Insurance experience and working familiarity of insurance underwriting operations and platform systems preferred.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working effectively across technical and business teams.

The pay range for this position is $180,000 to $262,500 annually. Actual compensation will vary based on multiple factors, including employee knowledge and experience, role scope, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.

Description:

Position:
Director, Technology Solutions

Classification:
Full-Time, Exempt

Reports to:
COO & Chief Data Scientist

Date:

MISSION:
Futuro Health launched in 2020 to address the critical shortage of workers in the healthcare sector. Our nonprofit mission is to improve the health and wealth of communities by growing the largest network of allied healthcare workers in the nation. Initially funded by a $130 million investment from Kaiser Permanente through a collective bargaining agreement with SEIU-UHW, Futuro Health has since grown to have a portfolio of funders, grants and contracts to do our work that is life changing. Every year, thousands of diverse adults become Futuro Health Scholars and pursue training to earn their credentials for a wide array of in-demand allied healthcare roles. What sets Futuro Health apart is our comprehensive approach to supporting Futuro Health Scholars throughout their education journey and our deep expertise in the healthcare sector. We address the healthcare workforce shortage by personalizing education journeys for diverse adults to enter into allied healthcare careers at low or no-cost. More on Futuro Health can be found at www.FuturoHealth.org.

OUR VALUES

Scholar Centered: We keep Scholars and equity at the center of our work.
Quality Solutions: We design quality solutions that are agile, inclusive, and scalable – for employers, partners, and communities.
Data-Driven Innovation: We continuously improve and innovate – and use data to inform our decisions.
Future Focused: We look toward the future and embrace new opportunities.
Collaborative: We earn and maintain trust through collaboration and acting with integrity and accountability.
Culture Matters: We steward our culture – and empower team members to contribute meaningfully.

Why Should You Join Futuro Health:
Do you seek to change lives for the better? Do you want a role in a nonprofit focused on designing solutions and bringing direct services to make a difference to Scholars, communities and the nation? Have you shown grit when it comes to taking on challenges and pushing forward to resolution? Our team of talents share a commitment to Futuro Health’s nonprofit mission. We celebrate the opportunity to transform lives through our purpose-driven work. We bring our skillsets, a can-do attitude, and a collaborative approach to our everyday work of forging workforce development models that apply best practices. We know it takes collective effort to design adult-friendly, inclusive, agile, and scalable solutions that meet the big challenges of the day -- ranging from worker shortages, social and economic mobility, to equity in care. If these qualities speak to you, apply to become part of the Futuro Health team.

Position Summary:
Futuro Health is seeking a Director of Technology Solutions to lead the strategic direction and operational execution of our technology infrastructure, data systems, and enterprise applications. This is a leadership role for someone who thinks like a technologist and solutions architect first — someone who can design, implement, and maintain reliable systems, direct and develop technical teams, and ensure the platforms powering our learner experience and enterprise are secure, scalable, well-governed, and responsive to business needs. This person will own our core technology infrastructure (built on .NET, SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Dynamics CRM), evaluate architecture and vendor decisions, and hold technical leaders accountable for delivery. The Director will partner with program, Scholar-facing and client-facing leadership, and other teams to translate organizational needs into technical solutions, including working closely with the Director of Instructional Design to ensure new learning tools integrate cleanly with the broader technology environment.

Essential Job Functions:

Technology & Infrastructure Oversight

Own the strategic and operational direction of IT infrastructure, software development, and data systems.
Ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of core enterprise systems (.NET applications, Microsoft Azure environment, SQL Server databases, Microsoft Dynamics CRM).
Lead architecture and platform decisions in partnership with the Manager of Software Development.
Oversee data governance, integrity, and systems strategy in partnership with the Senior Manager of Data Systems.
Evaluate vendor and build/buy tradeoffs for new technical solutions and budget recommendations/planning.
Ensure IT operations effectively support day-to-day organizational technology needs.

Solutions Delivery

Translate business and operational needs into scoped technical solutions, investment/budget strategy, and implementation plans.
Establish delivery processes (intake, prioritization, release management, budget chargeback) where they don't yet exist.
Oversee the technical execution of tools supporting instructional design, curriculum management, and learner-facing systems.
Monitor system performance and lead resolution of escalated and significant technical issues.
Prepare for and practice staff for crisis scenario response mitigation.

People Leadership

Directly manage and develop the IT Operations Manager, Senior Manager of Data Systems, and Manager of Software Development.
Build team capacity, set performance expectations, cultivate healthy culture, and support career growth for direct and indirect reports.
Lead across disciplines outside one's own technical background by empowering subject-matter experts and fostering trust and autonomy within teams.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across a cross-functional organization.
Ensure business continuity of business-critical functions, including documentation and cross training.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as a key advisor to senior leadership on technology and data strategy as tools, products and enablers of organizational goals.
Represent technology and infrastructure priorities in organizational planning and budgeting.
Oversee and partner with external vendors and consultants as appropriate.

Qualifications:

Required

7+ years of experience in technology leadership, with 2+ years managing high-performing teams across multiple sub-functions (infrastructure, engineering, data).
Demonstrated experience overseeing enterprise application architecture (e.g., .NET, Azure, SQL Server) and holding technical teams accountable for delivery.
Experience overseeing or partnering closely with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics CRM experience preferred).
Demonstrated ability to lead teams or functions outside one's core expertise — candidates must show strong judgment in setting direction and building trust with subject-matter experts.
Comfortable translating ambiguous organizational needs into structured technical solutions, budgets and project plans.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present to senior leadership.

Preferred

Experience in education technology, workforce development, healthcare, or nonprofit sectors.
Experience with data governance and reporting/analytics platforms.
Prior experience building or maturing a technology function in an organization that previously lacked one.

Education:

Required

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

Master's degree (MBA, MS in Information Systems, or similar), or equivalent experience.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), a Pragmatic Institute product certification, PMP, or ITIL Foundation.

Supervisory Responsibility:

added.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About The Role

As Senior Engineering Manager for Agent Platform & UX, you will lead two teams reimagining Render's onboarding and activation experience for both humans and AI agents.

One team owns the experience a person sees the first time they come to Render: signup, onboarding, activation, and what drives them to adopt more of the platform. The other team builds the equivalent experience for agents, which reach Render through APIs rather than the UI, integrating with providers like Codex, Claude, and Cursor so agents can use Render the way humans do. You'll take an already-forming org through its next stage of growth.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow two teams, UX (human onboarding and activation) and Agent Platform (the equivalent experience for agents via programmatic interfaces like the MCP, CLI, API, SDK, and Blueprints)
Own the roadmap for Render's self-serve user journey, from first touch through activation, initial monetization, usage expansion, new feature adoption, and PQL graduation
Drive the agent-facing side of the platform: build the API-driven experience that lets agents integrate with and operate on Render
Partner with the dedicated product and design partners on both teams to align roadmap with customer, growth, and platform needs
Hire and develop engineers to support planned team growth, while keeping both teams' identities and focus areas clear as they scale
Make key architectural and product decisions, balancing long-term platform investment against iterative improvements to onboarding and activation
Build a strong performance management and career development practice for a team that already includes senior ICs

What We're Looking For

Strong people leadership - the top priority for this role
Hands-on enough to review code, prototype, and contribute directly when it helps the team
Comfort operating in ambiguity, with adaptability and a growth mindset
Proven experience building and scaling more than one team, ideally growing a group from a handful of engineers into a larger org
Experience managing and developing senior (IC5+) engineers, including hiring and performance management
Ability to partner closely with product and design without needing to fill those functions yourself
Strong product instincts, with the ability to connect engineering investment to growth and activation outcomes
Background from a startup preferred, though experience at a larger company can work too. What matters is the ability to operate at pace

Nice-to-Haves

Prior growth-focused engineering experience (onboarding, activation, funnel optimization)
Experience building developer- or agent-facing product experiences, and integrating with AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude, or Cursor
Background in developer platforms or DevTools
Experience helping a team split or reorganize as it scales into multiple teams

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

4 weeks of paid vacation.
14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.
Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.
100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.
Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.
Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.
Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.
Continuous learning benefits & related support.
