Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we are building the next generation of cloud services for autonomous and intelligent robotics.

OCI Robotics Cloud is Oracle's strategic cloud platform for robotics. Our mission is to enable enterprises to seamlessly onboard, manage, monitor, and operate heterogeneous robot fleets through secure, scalable, AI-powered cloud services.

Unlike traditional robotics platforms that focus on individual robots, OCI Robotics Cloud is building the cloud operating system for robotics—providing common services for robot identity, registration, fleet management, mission orchestration, telemetry, digital twins, software lifecycle management, and AI-powered automation.

A key part of our vision is an AI-driven, spec-based robot onboarding platform
that enables robots from any vendor to integrate rapidly through standardized cloud interfaces, reusable edge services, and AI-generated service contracts.

As Director of OCI Robotics Cloud, you will build both the platform and the organization that will define Oracle's long-term robotics strategy.

This is a rare opportunity to build a greenfield cloud platform with executive visibility and industry-wide impact at the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, robotics, and edge computing.

Responsibilities

About You

You are a builder.

You enjoy creating organizations, platforms, and engineering cultures from the ground up.

You have successfully led engineering teams building large-scale cloud platforms and understand how to balance long-term technical vision with rapid execution.

You believe great platforms are built around reusable abstractions, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

You are passionate about AI and understand how generative AI can fundamentally improve software engineering, developer experience, and platform automation.

You have a proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and growing exceptional engineering organizations.

You communicate effectively with engineers, architects, product leaders, customers, and executive leadership.

What You'll Do

Define the Platform

Define the long-term architecture and technical vision for OCI Robotics Cloud.
Build the cloud platform enabling robot registration, identity, fleet management, mission orchestration, telemetry, digital twins, and software lifecycle management.
Establish common APIs, service contracts, SDKs, and edge service frameworks that support robots from multiple vendors.

Lead AI-driven Engineering

Lead the development of an AI-assisted, spec-driven robot onboarding platform where AI generates service contracts, edge service specifications, SDKs, implementation guidance, and developer documentation.
Drive adoption of AI throughout the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity and platform quality.

Build the Organization

Recruit, mentor, and grow a world-class cloud engineering organization.
Build a culture centered on engineering excellence, ownership, customer obsession, and continuous innovation.
Coach engineering managers and senior technical leaders while developing future organizational leadership.

Deliver at Scale

Drive engineering execution across architecture, planning, prioritization, delivery, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence.
Partner closely with Product Management to define roadmap and customer adoption strategy.
Collaborate across OCI AI, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Networking, Developer Services, and strategic robotics partners.
Represent OCI Robotics Cloud in executive reviews, customer engagements, and strategic technology initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field.
12+ years of experience building distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software platforms.
5+ years of engineering management experience leading multiple software engineering teams.
Proven experience defining and delivering large-scale cloud platforms from concept to production.
Strong technical background in distributed systems, Kubernetes, APIs, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and modern software engineering practices.
Demonstrated success hiring and scaling engineering organizations.
Outstanding communication, leadership, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud robotics, IoT, autonomous systems, or edge computing platforms.
Familiarity with ROS 2 and modern robotics software architectures.
Experience with DDS, MQTT, OPC-UA, VDA5050, or related robotics communication technologies.
Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, APIs, or service contract frameworks.
Experience with AI-assisted software development, developer productivity platforms, or agentic AI systems.
Exposure to embodied AI, vision-language models, robot fleet management, digital twins, or teleoperation platforms.
Experience working with heterogeneous hardware ecosystems and partner integrations.

Why Join Us

Build Oracle's cloud platform for the next generation of intelligent robotics.
Pioneer AI-driven, spec-based robot onboarding technologies.
Define the open cloud interfaces that enable robots from any vendor to integrate with OCI.
Lead one of Oracle's newest strategic engineering organizations.
Collaborate with world-class engineers across OCI AI, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, and Developer Services.
Shape Oracle's long-term strategy for cloud robotics, AI, and autonomous systems.

Vision

Our vision is to make robot onboarding as simple as cloud onboarding.

We believe AI will fundamentally transform how robots are integrated into enterprise systems by automatically generating service contracts, edge services, SDKs, APIs, implementation guidance, and operational best practices.

OCI Robotics Cloud is building the cloud platform that allows any robot—from any vendor—to securely connect to Oracle Cloud through standardized interfaces rather than custom integrations.

As Director of OCI Robotics Cloud, you will build the engineering organization that turns this vision into reality.

added.title: Head of AI Driven Digital Customer Engagement Management Platform
added.description:
Job Title:
Head of AI- Driven Digital Customer Engagement Management Platform

Location: Morristown, NJ, Cambridge, MA

About The Job

Sanofi's Digital Business Horizon 2030 is to deliver best-in-class and first-in-class science faster to patients. Project Orion is a mandatory and strategic migration from OneCRM (end-of-support end-2029) to a new Customer Engagement Management Platform (CEMP), covering 13,000 users across 45 countries. This is not a like-for-like replacement — it is a leap forward to an AI-native, omnichannel customer engagement platform.

The Head of AI-Driven Digital Customer Engagement Management Platform holds a pivotal role responsible for leading the end-to-end implementation of Sanofi's new Customer Engagement Management Platform, including the deployment of Concierge for Field as the single conversational entry point for all customer-facing teams, and the transition from the current Veeva OneCRM system to the ExCom selected CEMP platform.

This role is central to Sanofi's Go-to-Market transformation, enabling all field-based teams to engage customers in a seamless, AI-augmented, and data-driven way. There is a significant investment envelope behind over the period from 2027–2030, making this one of the most strategically significant digital programs at Sanofi.

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

The Head of AI-Driven Digital Customer Engagement Management Platform is accountable for the successful delivery of Project Orion including concierge for Field, the strategic migration and transformation of Sanofi's customer engagement platform ecosystem. She/He will lead a cross-functional program team, partner closely with the GBUs, Markets, GTMC, and ensure the platform enables Sanofi's vision of an AI-augmented, customer-centric engagement at scale.

Program Leadership & Implementation

Lead successfully the end-to-end implementation of Project Orion, Sanofi's strategic migration from OneCRM to the new Customer Engagement Management Platform (CEMP), covering up to 13,000 users across ~ 45 countries by 2030 while driving exceptional user feedback.
Own the full program delivery lifecycle: from final vendor negotiations with procurement, platform configuration, ecosystem integration, data migration, to phased global rollout across US, China, and all other markets.
Drive the execution plan with platform vendor and system integrator, end-to-end ecosystem pressure testing, inventory of all interdependencies, governance and staffing (internal and external), detailed wave-by-wave rollout plan, and KPIs of success.
Oversee the rollout roadmap with an US first mindset, China, and other markets as per company country prioritization to full scale before lifecycle end of the current VeevaSalesforce platform.
Ensure OneCRM continuity and manage the license extension with Veeva through end 2029 to minimize implementation risk.
Manage diligently the investment envelope over 2027–2030, ensuring rigorous financial governance, milestone tracking, and value realization.
Lead Product ownership on consent and customer access management as a strategic layer of the platform and process revamp to break with the past and enable a future AI ready consent and customer ID management

Concierge for Field Deployment

Lead the scaling of Concierge for Field as the single conversational entry point for all customer-facing teams (field reps, MSLs, KAMs, market access, etc.), replacing direct CRM login with an AI-native, voice/chat-first interface in line with the overall Concierge one front strategy across the enterprise.
Own the Concierge for Field product roadmap and skills backlog, prioritizing capabilities based on business impact and accessibility (time to value) in intimate coordination with the US and key markets: e.g. Pre-Call Planning, Call Reporting, Objection Handling, Territory Analytics, Morning Brief, Reimbursement & Access Guidance, and all the upcoming specific capabilities that are being identified.
Scale Concierge for Field from current beta version to full production first across the US and then across all global field users, including a federated China deployment via WeCom/Tencent ADP.
Govern the skill prioritization framework (Impact x Accessibility matrix) in collaboration with Business Owners and GTMC counterparts.
Actively connect with the respective commercial analytics teams to ensure that roadmaps are coordinated and address interdependencies, as wells a clear governance is maintained in coordination of agents with the Agent hub as well as other AI analytical or agent uses cases in commercial analytics and AI PL, as well as the central data COE, concierge team.
Ensure the "headless CRM" architecture is fully implemented: Concierge as the front-end, CEMP as the invisible compliant backend system of record

Platform Architecture & AI

Ensure Sanofi owns the intelligence layer of customer engagement: data, AI logic, and orchestration remain Sanofi-owned and vendor-agnostic, regardless of the CRM platform selected.
Oversee the build of Sanofi's AI and agentic layer (built on Elementum AI / AWS Bedrock for global, Tencent ADP for China), delivering differentiated AI capabilities including omnichannel orchestration, proactive agentic workflows, and NBA/NBI signals, etc.
Manage the data foundation dependencies (USDF, LUCI, MDF, OneCustomer/Reltio) as critical prerequisites for Wave 1 go-live.
Ensure the core CRM & CEMP capabilities are reflected through re-designed workflows / Progressively automated or exposed natively through Concierge, reducing field admin time from ~30% to near-zero.

Stakeholder & Governance

Lead the Orion program governance together with the GTMC partners including SteerCo cadence, cross-functional workstream coordination (Digital key functions, GTMC, GBUs, markets, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, Cybersecurity).
Ensure continued outside-in perspective with constant sanity checks on benchmarking and best in class experiences.
Mobilize and manage effectively the program team (internal and external resources), including PMO, change management, digital build, agent development, and advisory workstreams.
Partner hand in have with GTMC and digital markets for change management, field adoption, and go-to-market alignment across all waves.
Serve as the primary interface between Digital, GBUs, and executive governance (Digital xGBU Tower, ExCom) for all CEMP-related decisions.
Communicate pro-actively program status, anticipate risks, and value delivery to senior leadership, and the respective key stakeholders, users to build enterprise-wide awareness.

Responsible AI

Ensure appropriate management of AI-related risks throughout the CEMP and Concierge for Field system lifecycle by ensuring ongoing compliance to Sanofi's Responsible AI internal standards & legal requirements (RAISE)
Ensure the execution of AI Governance tasks and compliance with controls throughout the AI system lifecycle, including (non-exhaustive): Validation and post-deployment monitoring, meeting all applicable quality, regulatory (Data Privacy, GxP, SOX, Artificial Intelligence), and cybersecurity requirements. Maintaining adherence to these standards across all AI products deployed within the CEMP ecosystem

Ways of working

You will be a member of the Global Digital GBU Leadership Team.
You will foster close partnerships and collaboration between cross-functional teams (GBUs, Digital, GTMC, Market teams, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, Cybersecurity) and drive structured ways of working between teams to provide maximum value and efficiency to business teams.
You will work closely and constructively with other development teams, e.g., Accelerator, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Data, and Web teams, whether inside or outside the company.
You will work in close partnership with key markets with an US first — to ensure digital solutions are grounded in market realities and deliver measurable impact.
You will empower your teams to set up lean but effective structures and efficient local governance.
You will build and develop a team that is accountable, uses complementary strengths and develop dedicated, strong, and diverse leaders and that can be a role model both technical skills as well as through its forward looking mindset.

About You

Technical skills:

10+ years of digital/technology experience with 5+ years in senior program or product leadership roles required
Deep knowledge of CRM platforms (Veeva or Salesforce) and pharma commercial technology stack preferred
Experience with AI orchestration platforms (Elementum, AWS Bedrock, Snowflake, Agentforce, or equivalent) preferred
Strong understanding of data foundations, middleware, and API/MCP integration architectures preferred
Experience with headless CRM and conversational AI deployment preferred
Familiarity with omnichannel orchestration, NBA/NBI engines, and personalization at scale preferred
Financial governance of large investment programs (business case, TCO, milestone tracking) preferred
Experience with AI-driven personalization platforms and omnichannel orchestration tools preferred
Experience with analytics tools and drawing actionable insights from data preferred
Knowledge of GxP, Data Privacy, SOX, and cybersecurity requirements in pharma digital systems preferred
Experience with agile delivery at scale and GSI (Global System Integrator) management preferred

Experience (preferred)

Large-scale digital platform implementation and program leadership (CRM, SaaS, enterprise platforms).
Experience managing multi-year, multi-hundred-million-euro digital transformation programs.
CRM platform expertise: Veeva Vault CRM and/or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud.
AI product development and agentic workflow deployment at enterprise scale.
Change management for large field force transformations (10,000+ users).
Experience running UX initiatives and/or leading AI, personalization, or Big Data initiatives at scale
Experience in pharmaceutical commercial operations (e.g. field force, medical affairs, market access).
Knowledge of Sanofi's GBU ecosystem and Go-to-Market model is a strong plus.

Soft Skills

Exceptional program leadership and executive stakeholder management.
Ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels simultaneously.
Strong influencing and alignment skills across complex, matrixed organizations.
Resilience and decisiveness in high-stakes, high-complexity environments.
Customer-obsessed mindset with a bias for simplification and user experience.
Multicultural and transversal collaboration across global teams.
Thoughtful risk-taking and structured problem-solving.
Deep experience in applying LEAN and Agile Practices
Inclusive and diverse leadership style.

Education

Bachelors Degree required; Advanced Scientific, Business or Engineering Degree, Marketing, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline is a plus.

Language

English a must, other languages a plus.

Travel
